sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Polikhim Hobo is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "The bum from Polikhim? What am I, the bloody king of every stray in Tarkov now?! Alright, I know who you're talking about, same as everyone else who's lived here. He wasn't a bad bloke, but he lost the plot when all this mess kicked off. You're looking for him, are you? I can help you out, but not out of the goodness of my heart. The Scavs have been getting under my feet lately, making things difficult. Go give them a proper scare, and then I'll tell you what I know. Here's the list of places that need clearing."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 25 Scavs on Interchange, Ground Zero or Woods

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,000 EXP
- Skier Rep +0.1
- 450 Euros
  - 473 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 518 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Your bum was staying by the train tracks, in a wagon near the boiler building. There's a bunker nearby as well, right by the tracks. My lads used to see him in that carriage all the time."
